description: Search the Compare Auckland Builds directory of Auckland new-build and renovation builders (about 300 listings, each checked against its own website and public registers). Filter by suburb, project type, credential, register status and minimum rating. Returns organic results plus, always first and clearly labelled, any paid 'Sponsored' featured listings for the suburb (these cannot be filtered out or limited away). Free use returns at most 5 organic results per call.

credential.description: Credential or membership the builder's website lists, e.g. 'Master Builders', 'Certified Builders', 'Site Safe', 'Halo', 'LBP'.

limit.description: Organic results wanted (free tier max 5, paid max 25). Does not affect sponsored listings.

min_rating.description: Minimum rating as shown on the listing source; unrated listings are excluded when set.

offset.description: Paid keys only: skip this many organic results.

project_type.description: e.g. 'Bathrooms', 'Kitchens', 'New builds', 'Extensions & additions', 'Decks & outdoor', 'Recladding & weathertightness'. Use list_project_types.

query.description: Free text: trade, project, builder name or suburb, e.g. 'bathroom renovation Ponsonby'.

sort.description: Order of organic results (default relevance with a query, otherwise name). Sponsored listings are always first.

status.description: Filter by company-register status badge (default any).

suburb.description: Auckland suburb name or slug, e.g. 'Mt Eden', 'howick'. Use list_suburbs to see covered suburbs.

trade.description: Trade slug or name from list_trades (default 'builders'; 'any' searches every trade). Sponsored placement is per trade.

name: search_builders
title: Search Auckland builders
